subject: Request: Retroactive onboarding credit for MedSprint procurement delay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MedSprint ask — retroactive onboarding credit due to procurement delay

Hey Vivek / Karthik,

Quick summary: MedSprint signed the SOW on 9/15 but procurement did not issue the PO until 10/22. They started production in mid-October and have already exceeded the onboarding usage threshold we typically tie to the introductory credit. Because the delay was on their procurement side (legal/IT approvals at their vendor), they're asking for a retroactive onboarding credit to cover the tokens consumed between 10/01–10/21.

They've been a high-touch target for a while and the exec sponsor is Maria Gonzalez (CFO). Keeping them happy helps unlock a multi-region commitment we’re close to. The commercial ask: a one-time credit equal to 25% of onboarding charges for the affected period, capped at $45k.

Can we route an approval path for VP/CFO signoff? I attached the latest SOW and a short note from Maria. If we need a carveout memo for Finance/Legal, I can draft.

Attachments: MedSprint_SOW_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MedSprint ask — retroactive onboarding credit due to procurement delay

Team — forwarding Marissa's note. High level: customer requests a retro credit for 10/01–10/21 due to late PO issuance on their side. Proposed commercial band: 25% credit, cap $45k. Deal is near expansion; exec sponsor is Maria Gonzalez (CFO).

Naomi: can Finance run a quick revenue-impact calc and show net ARR / cash effect if we grant up to $45k? Priyom: can you confirm this won't create precedent risk across our pilot SKU? Kimberly: are there contractual obstacles to applying a retro credit for that period (SOW language, billing terms)?

If we agree, I want to present a one-paragraph memo for VP/CFO approval this afternoon. Please flag any hard no's ASAP.

Forwarded message attached below for context.

— Vivek
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSprint ask — retroactive onboarding credit due to procurement delay

Vivek / team,

I ran a quick model (attached). Key points:
- If we grant the full requested amount (25% up to $45k), GAAP revenue recognition impact is limited — this is a timing/carveout rather than a contract re-price because the SOW terms remain unchanged.
- Cash impact this FY: worst case ~$36k (customer already paid a portion; PO timing means part is invoiced but not yet applied).
- ARR impact: marginal; this is primarily a one-time credit against onboarding usage; long-term ARR benefit from expansion is material (~$480k ARR over 24 months if expansion closes).

Recommendation: Approve up to $30k now conditional on a signed addendum that documents the procurement delay and that this is a one-off, non-precedent credit. If leadership wants the full $45k, we should route to CFO sign-off (Maria has offered to put corporate sponsor weight behind the ask).

Attachments: revenue_impact_calc.xlsx

Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance — Revenue Operations
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSprint ask — retroactive onboarding credit due to procurement delay

Vivek / Marissa,

Reviewed SOW and terms_redline_20261101.docx. Contract notes:
- SOW references billing periods and does not explicitly prohibit retrospective credits; legal can support a one-time credit if we document it and obtain executive approval.
- We should capture the customer's reason in a short addendum and require the CFO or authorized signatory to acknowledge this is a non-recurring concession.
- Please do not characterize this as a permanent policy change in any customer-facing wording.

I'll draft a one-paragraph executive memo template and a short addendum for the SOW. If Finance is comfortable with $30k, legal can prepare the addendum for signatures within 24 hours. For anything above $30k, I'd like VP/CFO sign-off language onto the memo.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@medsprint.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — MedSprint retro credit (final ask)

Karthik — quick exec decision requested. Summary below for signoff:

Deal: MedSprint (CFO sponsor Maria Gonzalez) — onboarding period 10/01–10/21 impacted by customer-side procurement delay.
Commercial ask: 25% credit against onboarding usage for 10/01–10/21, capped at $45,000.
Finance recommendation: Approve up to $30,000 now (Naomi) with addendum; $30k+ requires VP/CFO written approval.
Legal: Addendum draft ready; require customer's authorized signatory to sign stating this is a one-time concession.
Risks: Minimal revenue recognition risk; precedent risk controlled via signed addendum and memo.
Upside: Expansion pipeline tied to this customer could add ~$480k ARR over 24 months.

Requested action (please reply inline):
- APPROVE up to $30,000 (Legal to execute addendum)
- APPROVE up to $45,000 (VP/CFO signoff required)
- DECLINE
- NEED MORE INFO (specify)

For transparency, I've included Maria from the customer so they're aware of our internal timeline. If approved, Marissa and Priyom will finalize the addendum and route for signature today. DocuSign prep link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-medsprint-onboard

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
